scope: Source-only concrete board HALT correction proposal; no RTL mutation/build/runtime
decision: Candidate board-only use of existing donor HALTn; source-supported for ordinary HALT bus inhibition, independent review and dynamic proof still required
donor_support: HALTn sampled at enPhi1; Halti gates busAvail and canStart. Inflight bus states ignore busAvail and finish normally. Pending bus metadata and waitBusCycle/wClk retain the request and wait at the bus dependency. HALTn is functional despite single-step comment. BERR retry remains unsupported, but BERRn is constant high here. Read-modify-write pair is explicitly atomic via rmcIdle.
old_as_high_phase_sequence: Normal AS deassertion is at phi2 with bcComplete; MCU freeze becomes true after that edge. Board uses old AS in the clocked phase update, so cpu_phase advances4→5 then freezes; both phase enables/E/input sampling stop. On MCU release it resumes retained5, then6/7/0, not a free-running CPU-clock phase. Reset and RMC-specific paths are separately governed and not this normal command proof.
new_phase_sequence: cpu_phase continuously increments modulo8 when !pause_game; phi1 at0, phi2 at4. MCU HALT assertion is sampled on the next donor phi1, busAvail falls and ordinary subsequent bus start waits. Current accepted bus drains on normal DTACK/VPA. MCU release sampled on phi1 reopens a pending bus at a subsequent eligible bus phase. No new clock, fake wait count, E reinitialization, screenshot phase adjustment or guest mutation.
assert_release_limits: Halti is sampled on phi1, and the busPhase update reads its previous value at that same edge. Physical assertion/release therefore includes donor sampling latency. Source does not alone prove absence of every possible additional in-flight request at a coincident S6 edge; observer must record command_valid/main_halt/HALTi/canStart/busPhase/AS and accepted services. Do not claim exact MAME zero-time scheduler equivalence.
vma_iack: E/eCntr remains on normal phi2, while existing VPA synchronization, rVma phi1/phi2 and iStop/xVma are unchanged. IACK still uses VPAn=!iack; do not add special E-only enables or unfreeze arbitrary CPU state. Review actual next IACK phase after MCU release.
profile_equivalence: For profiles0/1, is_stingray=0 makes HALTn1, old MCU freeze false, and phi enables/counter behavior exactly identical for every phase/pause/MCU signal/AS value. Profile2 with MCU halt0 identical. User/OSD/HS pause_game still gates both phase enables and phase counter, and MCU pause behavior remains unchanged. Pause does not become physical HALT; its existing whole-game freeze is intentionally retained.
reset_equivalence: held_reset/extReset/pwrUp and phase initialization untouched. MCU reset clears main_halt; active profile0/1 keeps pin HALTn high. No firmware/ROM/sys/wrapper/clock source changed.
minimal_next_authorized_proof: Independent timing_crossings source review of exact patch

If root approves implementation: smallest necessary elaboration/synthesis and isolated HALT-interface simulation, then bounded readonly accepted-edge diagnostic of genuine MCU command/release/E and next IACK against original qualified overlap; retain strict raw arrays/actual exits
Observe all applied guest controls at actual CPU reads; input-phase mistakes and returned-point journal alias remain independent open gates
limits: Original PCB HALT wiring/possible external clock gating unknown
No source proof of work119/sprite600/RGB600 cause
No runtime, fit/timing result or release qualification
